original.statement: ReferenceGrants RBAC permission is added to the Gateway API Traefik controller in version 3.0.0.

decision.reason: The linked PR says it only adds ReferenceGrants to the Gateway API RBAC example in the dynamic reference documentation [ev-1f07b2650f2e]. Its one changed file is docs/content/reference/dynamic-configuration/kubernetes-gateway-rbac.yml [ev-d28c42488d88], and the changelog lists it under Documentation [ev-b93f05e6d823]. Because it does not change product behaviour, it does not support an upgrade exposure condition. No evidence says an environment fails or loses access when it uses ReferenceGrants. The version "v1beta1" in the proposed gvk-in-use leaf also appears nowhere in the evidence.
